opening.argument: The video leads viewers with an easy-income promise, claiming, “If you watch this video till the end then you can earn a lot of money.” It then directs them to download the application and promotes an “unlimited trick” involving multiple IDs, referral activity, and bypassing device limits to obtain additional cash. The instructions further involve multiple mobile numbers and OTP registration, while the demonstrated account and withdrawal process includes PAN information. Taken together, these are not merely neutral app demonstrations: they present low-barrier account creation and repeated participation as a route to recurring cash earnings.
